author: TheColdCrafter
body:
Ok. So in Walls, I was playing one of the maps that had Acacia trees. I don't know if anybody else found out about this. So kit lumberjack was made before the acacia update, so kit lumberjack dosent cause acacia or dark oak trees to timber like it does birch, oak, spruce, and jungle.
i feel like this should be fixed, but thats just me.
